## `s3.runId()`

```ts
runId(): string
```

Returns the run ID shared by all VUs in the process, intended to be
used as a key prefix such as `<runId>/<dataset>/<n>`. It is available in
the init context. It is the value of the `XK6_S3_RUN_ID` environment
variable if set, otherwise a random 8-character string. See [runId](../README.md#runid) in README.

## `s3.parseSize(size)`

```ts
parseSize(size: string): number
```

Returns the number of bytes of a size such as `"10MiB"` or
`"1.5GiB"`, in the same format as the sizes of the operations (see [Sizes](../README.md#sizes) in README), but not a size distribution. It throws on an
invalid size. Use it to compare sizes with the bytes of results, for
example to stop writing at a total size per VU:

```js
const limit = s3.parseSize("1GiB");
let written = 0;

export default function () {
  if (written >= limit) {
    return;
  }
  const res = client.putObject("bucket", `${s3.runId()}/${__VU}-${__ITER}`, "10MiB");
  written += res.bytes;
}
```

## `new s3.Client(config)`

```ts
new Client(config: ClientConfig): Client
```

A client of an S3-compatible server.

Create clients in the init context. The configuration is validated there,
and the underlying SDK client is created in each VU on its first
operation. Requests are sent through the VU's k6 HTTP transport, so
data_sent and data_received are recorded and the k6 TLS and connection
options (insecureSkipTLSVerify, tlsAuth, noConnectionReuse, ...) apply.

Operations cannot be called in the init context.

### `client.createBucket(bucket)`

```ts
createBucket(bucket: string): Result
```

Creates a bucket. For regions other than us-east-1, the
region is sent as the LocationConstraint.

### `client.deleteBucket(bucket)`

```ts
deleteBucket(bucket: string): Result
```

Deletes an empty bucket.

### `client.deleteObject(bucket, key)`

```ts
deleteObject(bucket: string, key: string): Result
```

Deletes an object.

### `client.deleteObjects(bucket, keys, options?)`

```ts
deleteObjects(bucket: string, keys: string[], options?: DeleteObjectsOptions): Result
```

Deletes up to 1000 objects with one DeleteObjects request,
measured as a delete_objects operation.

The result has the number of deleted objects in count and the number of
failed objects in failed. When any object fails, the result is not ok and
has the first per-object error.

Options: [`DeleteObjectsOptions`](#deleteobjectsoptions)

### `client.deletePrefix(bucket, prefix, options?)`

```ts
deletePrefix(bucket: string, prefix: string, options?: DeletePrefixOptions): Result
```

Deletes all objects whose keys start with prefix
concurrently, for use in teardown(). The prefix must not be empty. Each
ListObjectsV2 request is measured as a list operation and each deletion
as a delete operation.

The result has the number of deleted objects in count, the number of
failed objects in failed and the first error. It is ok when no object
failed.

Options: [`DeletePrefixOptions`](#deleteprefixoptions)

### `client.getObject(bucket, key)`

```ts
getObject(bucket: string, key: string): Result
```

Downloads an object and discards the body.

### `client.headObject(bucket, key)`

```ts
headObject(bucket: string, key: string): Result
```

Retrieves the object metadata.

### `client.listObjects(bucket, prefix, options?)`

```ts
listObjects(bucket: string, prefix: string, options?: ListObjectsOptions): Result
```

Lists objects under the prefix with ListObjectsV2. Each
request (page) is measured as a list operation.

The result has the total number of listed objects in count, and the
status, request ID and error of the last request. Common prefixes are not
counted.

For example, to get the listed objects in order:

```js
const r = client.listObjects(bucket, prefix, { maxPages: 0, keys: true });
for (const key of r.keys) {
  client.getObject(bucket, key);
}
```

Options: [`ListObjectsOptions`](#listobjectsoptions)

### `client.preload(bucket, prefix, count, size, options?)`

```ts
preload(bucket: string, prefix: string, count: number, size: Size, options?: PreloadOptions): Result
```

Uploads count objects named prefix + "0" ... prefix + (count-1)
with the given size concurrently, for use in setup(). Each upload is
measured as a put operation.

The result has the number of uploaded objects in count, the number of
failed objects in failed, the total bytes in bytes and the first error.
It is ok when no object failed.

Options: [`PreloadOptions`](#preloadoptions)

### `client.putObject(bucket, key, size)`

```ts
putObject(bucket: string, key: string, size: Size): Result
```

Uploads an object of the given size (a number, a string with a
unit or a size distribution) with a body generated on the Go side.

### `client.putObjectMultipart(bucket, key, size, options?)`

```ts
putObjectMultipart(bucket: string, key: string, size: Size, options?: PutObjectMultipartOptions): Result
```

Uploads an object with a multipart upload.

Like the aws-sdk-go-v2 upload manager, the checksum algorithm (CRC32
unless configured) is set on CreateMultipartUpload and UploadPart when
checksum is when_supported, and the part checksums are sent with
CompleteMultipartUpload. If any request fails, the upload is aborted.

The whole upload is measured as put_multipart and each part as
upload_part. The timeout applies to each request.

Options: [`PutObjectMultipartOptions`](#putobjectmultipartoptions)

## Types

### `ClientConfig`

The configuration of a client. Unknown keys are rejected. The
environment variables are read from the environment of the k6 process,
not from `-e` / `__ENV`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | `string` | `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3`, then `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL` | The endpoint URL (`http://` or `https://`). Required unless set by the environment variables. |
| `region` | `string` | `AWS_REGION`, then `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, then `"us-east-1"` | The region for signing. It is also sent as the LocationConstraint of createBucket unless us-east-1. |
| `accessKey` | `string` |  | The access key ID. When neither accessKey nor secretKey is set, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN are used. |
| `secretKey` | `string` |  | The secret access key. |
| `sessionToken` | `string` |  | The session token. |
| `pathStyle` | `boolean` | `true` | Uses path-style addressing. |
| `checksum` | `"when_supported" \| "when_required"` | `"when_supported"` | Applied to both request checksum calculation and response checksum validation. See [Request format](../README.md#request-format) in README. |
| `checksumAlgorithm` | `"CRC32" \| "CRC32C" \| "CRC64NVME" \| "SHA1" \| "SHA256"` |  | The request checksum algorithm. The SDK default (CRC32) if not set. Cannot be used with checksum when_required. |
| `payloadSigning` | `"auto" \| "unsigned" \| "signed"` | `"auto"` | Selects how the payload is signed. See [Request format](../README.md#request-format) in README. |
| `timeout` | `string \| number` | `"60s"` | The timeout of an operation. A duration string such as `"30s"` or milliseconds. |
| `maxAttempts` | `number` | `1` | The maximum number of attempts including SDK retries. Retries are disabled by default. An integer at least 1. |
| `tags` | `("bucket" \| "size_class")[]` |  | The optional metric tags to enable. |
| `tracing` | [`TracingConfig`](#tracingconfig) |  | The tracing of operations. |

### `TracingConfig`

The tracing configuration. See [Tracing](../README.md#tracing) in README.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sampleRate` | `number` | `0.01` | The ratio of operations traced with spans. Failed operations are always traced. A number in [0, 1]. |
| `propagate` | `boolean` |  | Adds the W3C `traceparent` header to the requests of traced operations. |

### `DeleteObjectsOptions`

The options of deleteObjects.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quiet` | `boolean` |  | Requests the quiet mode, in which the response lists only the failed keys. Not quiet by default, as the S3 API and minio-go. |

### `DeletePrefixOptions`

The options of deletePrefix.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concurrency` | `number` | `16` | The number of concurrent deletions. An integer at least 1. |

### `ListObjectsOptions`

The options of listObjects.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxKeys` | `number` |  | The MaxKeys of each request. The server default (1000 on S3) if 0 or not set. It limits the objects and the common prefixes together. An integer at least 0. |
| `maxPages` | `number` | `1` | The number of pages to fetch, 0 for all pages. An integer at least 0. |
| `delimiter` | `string` |  | The Delimiter of each request. Without it, all objects under the prefix are listed. With it, the objects in the next levels are grouped into common prefixes. |
| `keys` | `boolean` |  | Returns the listed keys in keys and the common prefixes in prefixes of the result. |

### `PreloadOptions`

The options of preload.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concurrency` | `number` | `16` | The number of concurrent uploads. An integer at least 1. |

### `PutObjectMultipartOptions`

The options of putObjectMultipart. The
defaults follow the aws-sdk-go-v2 upload manager.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partSize` | `string \| number` | `"5MiB"` | The part size. A size such as `"5MiB"` or a number of bytes, but not a size distribution. At least 1 byte. |
| `concurrency` | `number` | `5` | The number of parts uploaded at once. An integer at least 1. |

### `Result`

The result of an operation.

S3 and network errors do not throw. Each operation returns a result, so
that an error does not abort the iteration. Only script errors (invalid
arguments, calls in the init context) throw. The first few failures of
each operation type are logged as warnings with the request ID.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | Reports whether the operation succeeded. |
| `status` | `number` | The HTTP status code, 0 for network errors. |
| `bytes` | `number` | The number of body bytes sent or received. |
| `errorKind` | `string` | The kind of the error: s3, http, timeout, network, canceled or other. Empty on success. |
| `errorCode` | `string` | The S3 error code such as NoSuchKey or SlowDown, for s3 errors. |
| `error` | `string` | The error message. Empty on success. |
| `requestId` | `string` | The x-amz-request-id of the response. |
| `count` | `number` | The number of objects listed, uploaded or deleted by listObjects, deleteObjects, preload and deletePrefix. |
| `failed` | `number` | The number of failed objects in deleteObjects, preload and deletePrefix. |
| `keys` | `string[] \| null` | The listed keys of listObjects with the keys option, otherwise null. |
| `prefixes` | `string[] \| null` | The listed common prefixes of listObjects with the keys option, otherwise null. |

### `Size`

A size: a number of bytes, a string with a binary unit such as `"1MiB"`, or a size distribution.
See [Sizes](../README.md#sizes) in README.

```ts
type Size =
  | number
  | string
  | { dist: "uniform"; min: number | string; max: number | string }
  | { dist: "lognormal"; median: number | string; sigma: number }
  | { dist: "choice"; values: { size: number | string; weight: number }[] };
```
